mentions.name: Support Toolbox
mentions.description: This support workflow app adds text expansion alongside its existing support tooling, now covering everything the author needs for a day job in support; the latest improvements are pending release.
mentions.problem: The author's support workflow lacked built-in text expansion, which required relying on a separate app.
mentions.source_excerpt: I also made some improvements to my support workflow app, Support Toolbox [2], but haven't released those yet (hopefully this week). It now also includes text expansion, which I was really missing from my workflow and had been using another app for previously. At this point, it does pretty much everything I need it to do.
mentions.author: rijavecb
